extraction.notes: Full pass 1 extraction under rules 0.4 from the converted text file. Read the table of contents (pages 2-3), the whole of section 1.2 Summary of the report (pages 4-9), the public administration reform section (pages 13-17), the Chapter 2 section and Cluster 2 introduction (pages 68-71) and Chapter 10 (pages 79-80) in full, and screened every other section with a keyword search (digital, electronic, e-, online, data, cyber, artificial intelligence, interoperab, broadband, identification, portal, internet, software, IT, platform, register, website), reading each hit in context. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. Period covered from footnote 2 of the report (June 2021 to June 2022); the register field is empty. Chapter 2 contains no technology element and no anti-corruption measure tied to Chapter 2. The report contains no reference to artificial intelligence. Left out as outside the materiality test: the automated court case management system ACCMIS and the judiciary IT strategy (back-office), HRMIS and IFMIS, SCPC software, electoral biometric identification devices, cybercrime enforcement and statistics (R21), interception of communications, the asylum database, PNR data, IPR enforcement data platform, payment systems and crypto-assets (digital finance), customs paperless processing and intelligence systems, intelligent transport and electronic freight information (R22), electronic registers for guarantees of origin (energy), farm register and LPIS interoperability, phytosanitary and food alert systems, the SiReRa regional development system, the 112 number (R20), online media regulation and disinformation (media), and automatic exchange of tax information with EU Member States (no electronic system named). Doubtful cases kept are flagged theme_doubtful. Claims repeated between the summary, cluster introductions and chapter sections are extracted at each place (R10). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/. MKD-EU-2022-001-0138 added from the stage 9 recheck.
